grid.tile_bbox: union of the candidate bounding boxes in the tile, so a way that crosses a cell edge is still found

notice: Clearance candidates: OSM objects that carry a height tag. Their meaning is not established until validation. Source-reported, uneven and incomplete. Not a route, passage or safety statement. See LICENSE-DATA.md.

RI.reason: RI.json is the version 1 pilot file that the shipped client reads. A national rebuild would change its format.
RI.release_gate: Release a client that reads kamptrail-clearances-3 tiles, then review and rebuild RI under this schema.

terminology: Records are clearance candidates. Each is an OSM object with a height tag. status and comparable say how far the value can be compared. Their meaning is not established until validation.
